subject: Private offer drawdown rotation for DataForge - scheduling and ops questions
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@dataforge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@dataforge.com
Date: 2026-02-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private offer drawdown rotation plan for DataForge

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks again for taking time last week. Our finance team ran the numbers and they want the private offer to follow a rotational drawdown schedule so spend is spread evenly across Q2 and Q3 instead of a big frontload. They asked for:

- A monthly drawdown table mapping to GCP SKUs (token/instance equivalency is fine)
- Invoicing cadence (monthly preferred) and whether any credits will appear as marketplace line items or separate vendor credits
- Expected redemption window for private offers and any minimum redemption thresholds

I've attached the signed PO stub we have on our side. Can you confirm whether Redwood can support a rotational/tiered drawdown and, if so, provide a short proposal spreadsheet by EOD Thursday? Also please advise who from Redwood will be our partner contact for marketplace co-sell coordination.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Senior Procurement Manager
DataForge, Inc.
[Attachment: PO_DataForge_2026-02.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@dataforge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer drawdown rotation plan for DataForge

Samantha - thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely support a rotational drawdown; attached is a proposal that lays out two options so your finance team can pick which aligns best with internal forecasting:

Option A - Even monthly burn: equal drawdown each month for 6 months.
Option B - Rotation with runway: light first and last month, heavier middle months to match ramp.

Key notes:
- We can map credits to the private offer as marketplace line items; invoices can be monthly and we can include a breakdown by GCP SKU family and by token-equivalent buckets for easier reconciliation.
- Merchant onboarding for co-sell requires a partner contact; recommending we loop in CloudResell (their channel partner) to help map SKUs to marketplace SKUs and confirm redemption window.
- DocuSign is fine for signature, or we can accept a signed PO like the one you sent and generate an invoice schedule against it.

I've included a proposed schedule spreadsheet: RDW-DFG-Drawdown-Proposal.xlsx. If DataForge prefers, we can frontload up to 20% in month 1 to help with initial usage, but that would change month-over-month receipts.

Can you confirm: 1) preferred option (A or B), 2) billing contact for SAP/AR, and 3) does DataForge require us to set a usage cap or hard stop if a monthly redemption threshold is missed?

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Marketplaces & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW-DFG-Drawdown-Proposal.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@dataforge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@dataforge.com
Date: 2026-02-19T14:29:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer drawdown rotation plan for DataForge

Marissa - this looks good, thanks. A few follow ups from our legal/ops team (copying their questions inline):

> On 2026-02-19 11:03, Marissa Cole wrote:
> > Key notes:
> > - We can map credits to the private offer as marketplace line items; invoices can be monthly...

1) Legal wants to know whether the private offer redemption will create marketplace credit that DataForge sees on the GCP invoice, or whether credits will be issued by Redwood off-invoice. They prefer on-invoice mapping for easier audit.
2) Ops needs a partner contact who can confirm SKU mapping and help with the redemption test. Please include that contact in the thread.
3) Procurement asked whether Redwood can include a naming convention we can pass to GCP (campaign code) so invoice reconciliation is automated.

Looping in our partner contact for co-sell: Michael Torres at CloudResell (michael.torres@cloudresell.com). Michael - are you available for a short call tomorrow to walk through SKU mapping and redemption windows?

Cheers,
Samantha

---- Original message quoted ----

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@dataforge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private offer drawdown rotation plan for DataForge

Samantha / Marissa / Michael - quick internal ops note to close the loop on Redwood side: 

- We can map credits to appear on the GCP invoice as marketplace line items; that is our default for private offers when requested. That satisfies the on-invoice audit requirement.
- Campaign code: we'll use RDF-DATAFORGE-026 to tag redemptions. Please confirm this string so we can include it in the private offer metadata.
- Redemption window: standard is 12 months from activation; if you need a hard stop earlier we can set expirations per tier.
- Usage cap: engineering ops can set soft caps and alerting; if DataForge wants a hard stop we need a signed trigger policy.
- Next steps:
  1) Michael / CloudResell to confirm SKU mapping tomorrow and verify the redemption test.
  2) Marissa to publish the private-offer in GCP once we have campaign code and signed PO.
  3) I will raise an internal ops ticket to set month-3 soft cap threshold at 75% of expected burn unless you ask otherwise.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/HS-28764 and draft schedule in Drive: https://drive.google.com/rdw/1a2b3c4d5e6f

If that all works I can generate the DocuSign envelope and the invoice schedule.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Operations | Redwood Inference
